title: Mikumi National Park: The Easiest Safari From Dar es Salaam
excerpt: Mikumi is the most accessible park from Dar es Salaam, with open plains and good wildlife. A good choice for a short safari.
body:
Mikumi National Park lies about four to five hours by road from Dar es Salaam. Its open Mkata floodplain is often compared to a small Serengeti.

## Wildlife

Elephants, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, wildebeest, impalas, lions and hippos in pools. Birdlife is rich.

## Why Mikumi

- Accessible by road from Dar es Salaam.
- Good for a two- or three-day safari.
- Combines with [Udzungwa](/blog/udzungwa-mountains-hiking/) and [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/).

## The highway

A main road runs through part of the park. That makes access easy, but it means some traffic noise in that area.

## When

Good all year; dry season is best for wildlife viewing.

## Who it suits

Travellers with limited time who start in Dar es Salaam, or who want to combine a short safari with the coast.
